# American Congress of Rehabilitation Medicine (ACRM)

> ACRM is a professional organization providing rehabilitation medicine career resources, job placement services, and member authentication for healthcare professionals.

ACRM operates a dedicated job board connecting rehabilitation medicine professionals with healthcare career opportunities across major medical centers and health systems. The organization serves as a central hub for career development and professional networking in the rehabilitation medicine field.

## Key Topics

- Rehabilitation Medicine
- Healthcare Careers
- Job Board
- Medical Jobs
- Career Portal
- Job Search
- Healthcare Recruitment
- ACRM Membership
- Authentication
- Career Development
- Medical Professionals
- Job Listings
- Account Access

## Career Resources

- [ACRM Rehab Job Board](https://careers.acrm.org/): ACRM's dedicated job board for finding rehabilitation medicine careers and medical positions across healthcare organizations

## Member Services

- [Member Sign In](https://my.acrm.org/ACRM/Contacts/Sign_In.aspx?LoginRedirect=true&returnurl=/party.aspx?ID=19166&WebsiteKey=36d39f2c-0c97-455e-930d-0abc59d5b17b): ACRM account login and authentication portal for member access to exclusive resources and services
